visualCharacteristics.purpose: tab strip over a bordered panel

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: tab label | panel content (rich text, or a link to a /fragments/ path to load blocks such as accordions)

usage.when: make/track a claim tabs, claim steps, coverage option tabs

reuseGuidance: alt for pill tabs over FAQ accordions, steps for numbered claim steps (each top-level heading starts a step), tiles for coverage item tiles, shadow for a raised panel.
